{{Other people|Stéphane Roux}}

'''Stéphane Roux''' (born 1960) is a French physicist specializing in surface mechanics and fractures. He is director of research at the [[École normale supérieure de Cachan]].  He was awarded the [[Société française de physique]] annual prix Daniel Guinier and the [[Médaille d'argent]] of [[CNRS]] in 2006<ref>[http://www.cnrs.fr/fr/recherche/prix/docs/2006argent_web.pdf Médaille d'argent du CNRS] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120716185003/http://www.cnrs.fr/fr/recherche/prix/docs/2006argent_web.pdf |date=2012-07-16 }}</ref><ref>[http://www.lemonde.fr/savoirs-et-connaissances/article/2005/06/30/stephane-roux-physique-et-mecanique_667229_3328.html Conference]</ref>

* Disorder and Fracture (Nato Science Series B: (closed)) by J.C. Charmet, E. Guyon and Stéphane Roux (Jan 31, 1991)
